text:
alex: hey team — my Okta invite link expired (alex@redwood.ai). Can't finish 1Password enrollment and I don't have the onboarding GDrive folder. Who should I ping for a temp seat or a reissued invite? Also my yubikey hasn't arrived; is there a passkey fallback?
jenna-peopleops: hi @alex — sorry about that. Re-sent the Okta invite just now (subject: 'Okta Invite — Redwood Inference'). I also opened a seat request, should be quick. Check your spam too. :wave:
mike-ops: if 1Password still says "account not provisioned" that's because seats are managed by People Ops. Jenna will add you. In the meantime, if you need CLI quickly we can give a short-lived token (DM).
alex: I got the new Okta link, thanks. After signing in, `op signin` still errors: "account not provisioned" — what's the exact flow to finish?
jenna-peopleops: adding the 1Password seat now, should propagate within 5-10m. I'll post when it's live. yubikey shipping ETA is ~3 business days. If you need access sooner reply with "temp-pass" and I'll DM a rotated password (will expire).
sam-sre: also added you to the onboarding-readers Google group so you should have the folder: /Onboarding/Redwood. If it's not visible try fully logging out of Google and back in. For repo access before GitHub SSO is active we can accept an SSH pub key or create a temporary PAT. Which do you prefer? :thinking_face:
alex: prefer SSH key. Do you want me to paste the pub key here or DM it?
sam-sre: DM preferred. Quick snippet for key gen if helpful:
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C \"alex@redwood.ai\"
# public key will be in ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
```
it-bot: ticket #INC-2026-983 created and assigned to people-ops for seat/Okta reprovision. ETA 30m.
alex: sent pub key via DM. 1Password seat shows active now — `op signin` succeeded 🎉. GDrive folder visible after logging out/in. SSH clone worked. Thanks all.
jenna-peopleops: welcome aboard, @alex! I'll follow up with yubikey tracking and add you to the team channels. Ping here if anything else pops up. :tada:
mike-ops: :thumbsup: Pro tip — if you hit MFA redirect loops, try an incognito window or clear saved credentials at https://accounts.google.com/ then re-auth.
